sources.snippet: rtmlib rtmlib is a super lightweight library to conduct human and animal pose estimation based on RTMPose and ViTPose models WITHOUT any dependencies like mmcv, mmpose, mmdet, etc. Basically, rtmlib only requires these dependencies: numpy opencv-python opencv-contrib-python onnxruntime Optionally, you can use other common backends like opencv, onnxruntime, openvino, tensorrt to accelerate the ...
